interpretation.upperRoof: Planar reconstruction constrained by laser roof sections and official oblique photograph; simplified intersecting roof network.
interpretation.body: Wall envelope inferred from laser eave/facade sections and photos, approximately 0.5-0.7 m plan uncertainty; original OSM footprint is retained separately.
interpretation.openings: Visible counts on northeast and pond facades reviewed in photographs; dimensions and other facade openings are display estimates.
interpretation.extensions: Terrace, awning, stair and courtyard gallery are photo/orthophoto-informed estimates; no surveyed construction dimensions. The southwest upper gable stays inside the laser-supported roof limit; projecting gallery below is separate.
interpretation.materials: Photo-interpreted colours and procedural geometry; source images are not embedded or redistributed.
